```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

options(
  htmltools.dir.version = FALSE,
  knitr.table.format = "html",
  knitr.kable.NA = '',
  dplyr.width = Inf,
  width = 250
)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.path = "figs/",
  fig.width = 7.252,
  fig.height = 4,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.retina = 3
)

# Vehicle listings summary table
summary_dt_raw <- read_csv(here('data', 'listings_summary.csv')) %>%
  filter(vehicle_type %in% c('car', 'cuv', 'suv')) %>%
  filter(powertrain %in% c('cv', 'hev', 'bev', 'phev')) %>%
  mutate(
    vehicle_type = ifelse(vehicle_type == 'cuv', 'suv', vehicle_type),
    vehicle_type = ifelse(vehicle_type == 'car', 'Car', 'SUV')
  ) %>%
  group_by(powertrain, vehicle_type, inventory_type) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(n = round(n / 10^6, 1))

total_listings <- sum(summary_dt_raw$n)
summary_dt <- summary_dt_raw %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = powertrain,
    values_from = n
  ) %>%
  select(
    Type = vehicle_type,
    Conventional = cv,
    Hybrid = hev,
    PHEV = phev,
    BEV = bev,
    inventory_type
  ) %>%
  mutate(PHEV = ifelse(is.na(PHEV), 0, PHEV)) %>%
  rename(ICEV = Conventional, HEV = Hybrid)
```

# [**Decades of Policy Whiplash**]{.center}

::: {.col .fragment}

### Obama<br>(2009–2016)

- $7,500 EV tax credit
- Goal: 1M EVs by 2015
- DOE battery R&D investment

:::

::: {.col .fragment}

### Trump I<br>(2017–2020)

- Proposed eliminating EV tax credits
- Rolled back fuel economy standards
- Withdrew from Paris Agreement

:::

::: {.col .fragment}

### Biden<br>(2021–2024)

- IRA: $369B in clean energy investment
- Expanded EV credits, domestic content rules
- 100% EV federal fleet goal

:::

::: {.col .fragment}

### Trump II<br>(2025–Now)

- Gutted IRA
- Rolled back fuel economy standards

:::

# How should the US respond to Chinese EVs?

---

## [Bipartisan Response: **Ban Chinese tech**]{.center}

::: {.col}

![](images/lutnick.png){fig-align="center" width=100%}

:::

::: {.col}

### **Block imports**: Steep tariffs on imported Chinese EVs, batteries (First Biden, continued w/Trump)

<br>

### **Block investment**: Stricter Foreign Entities of Concern (FEOC) rules

<br>

### **Ban the tech**: Connected Vehicle Security Act of 2026 bans any connected vehicles with Chinese tech (import or domestic)

:::

---

<br><br><br>

::: {.col}

## [Option A]{.center}

## [**Exclude Chinese EVs**]{.center}

<br>

### - China "cheated" with subsidies

### - Need to protect local automakers from Chinese competition

:::

::: {.col .fragment}

## [Option B]{.center}

## [**Engage strategically**]{.center}

<br>

### - China built real competitive advantages in manufacturing and supply chains

### - Chinese EVs are winning markets, US OEMs are losing markets

### - Actually address security concerns

:::

---

::: {.col}

## [The Tesla Example:<br>Transparent Cybersecurity]{.center}

<br>

### China allowed Tesla in via<br>targeted compliance:

- Store vehicle data **within China**
- Restrict operations near **sensitive areas**
- Use only **government-approved** mapping systems (Baidu)

:::

::: {.col}

<br>

![](images/tesla.png){fig-align="center" width=70%}

:::

---

## [The European Model:<br>Block Imports, Welcome Chinese FDI]{.center}

<br>

::: {.center .font120}
Access to cutting-edge battery tech

Create local jobs

Increase supply chain resilience
:::

. . .

<br>

::: {.col}

### [**CATL**]{.center}

$7.6B battery plant in Debrecen<br>

100 GWh/year for Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Volkswagen

:::

::: {.col}

### [**BYD**]{.center}

First European EV manufacturing facility<br>

Producing BEVs and PHEVs for the European market

:::

---

# [US Opportunities]{.center}

::: {.col}

## [Technology Licensing Agreements]{.center}

<br>

### **Ford-CATL**: Licensing battery technology in a Michigan plant

### **Challenge**: CATL recently added to DOD's list of "Chinese military companies"

:::

::: {.col .fragment}

## [Chinese FDI<br>into U.S.]{.center}

<br>

### **Gotion batteries**: Multi-billion dollar investments in Illinois and Michigan

### **Challenge**: Uncertainty around Foreign Entities of Concern (FEOC) status

:::

## The U.S. risks becoming an **"island of tailpipes"**

---

# [Strategic Responses]{.center}

### 🇨🇦🇲🇽 **North American Integration**: Build sufficient scale through Canada and Mexico partnerships

. . .

### 📋 **Transparent Security Standards**: Develop compliance frameworks all connected vehicles must meet — *regardless of origin*

. . .

### 🔋 **Battery Manufacturing Focus**: Prioritize domestic production as platform for commercializing next-gen U.S. technologies

. . .

### 🤝 **Strategic Chinese Partnerships**: Pursue licensing agreements and FDI with targeted safeguards — not wholesale restrictions

. . .

### 📈 **Sustained Policy Support**: Restore and maintain IRA incentives long enough for investments to mature

# How hard is it to get to a PEV dealer?

---

{{< bg-color "#fff" >}}

### **Vehicle accessibility metric**:<br>Road travel time from census tract centroid to<br>nearest dealership with a target vehicle

![](images/pev-access-diagram.png){fig-align="center" width=100%}

*Road travel times obtained using Open Source Routing Machine (OSRM)

---

{{< middle >}}

::: {.col width="65%"}

![](images/travel_time_pev_cv_cfp.png){fig-align="center" width=100%}

:::

::: {.col}

## PEV travel times are converging towards conventional vehicle times

80% of pop:

- CV in ~12 min
- PEV in ~22 min (2024)
- PEV in ~60 min (2016)

:::

---

{{< middle >}}

::: {.col width="65%"}

![](images/cfp_grid.png){fig-align="center" width=100%}

:::

::: {.col}

### Additional travel times (PEV - CV) by demographic blocks shows disparities

Places with worse PEV access:

- Lower income areas
- Rural areas
- Republican strongholds

:::
